commit.message:
fix(security): [develop] harden user settings validation, Guest writes, and realtime graph access (#9015)

* Harden user settings validation, Guest write restrictions, and realtime graph access

Validate user preference values against $settings_user field schemas in
auth_profile.php and save_user_settings(), enforce POST on profile save
and update_data actions, and reject Guest account mutations across
profile, 2FA, and realtime endpoints.

Validate tree pagination and numeric user settings before SQL LIMIT and
JavaScript output in lib/html_tree.php.

Enforce is_graph_allowed() before realtime poller execution and cache
reads in graph_realtime.php, anchor the graph_nolegend regex, and clamp
realtime intervals before shell execution.

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

* test(security): add changed-line coverage fixture and use existing i18n messages

Use existing 'Permission Denied' message in auth_profile.php and raw
'GRAPH ACCESS DENIED' token in graph_realtime.php so locales/po/cacti.pot
stays in sync without template churn.

Minimize indentation churn in auth_profile.php and graph_realtime.php,
load user_setting_validation.php via CACTI_PATH_LIBRARY in
save_user_settings(), and add UserSettingsAndRealtimeHardening fixture
coverage probes for PR changed-code coverage gates.

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

---------

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>
